tytul: Concentrated red borscht: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for concentrated Polish red borscht (barszcz czerwony), a soured beet liquid, canned in a boiling-water bath. [T:-]

ostrzezenia.tekst: NCHFP cans beets (whole, cubed or sliced, covered with water) only in a pressure canner. [T:ACI-447]
Low-acid foods, with a pH above 4.6, such as beets, cannot be safely canned in a boiling-water bath unless they are acidified according to a tested recipe. [T:ACI-449]

akapity: Beet is a vegetable, and all fresh vegetables except most tomatoes are low-acid foods with a pH above 4.6. [T:ACI-005]
NCHFP says canned soups should not be thickened, and its procedure for soups is for a pressure canner. [T:ACI-448]
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe that shows how much acid makes a beet concentrate safe for a boiling-water bath. [T:-]
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for concentrated red borscht from a checked source. [T:-]
